title: Native transport and Foreign Runtime boundary
summary: API Client v0.3 supplies a native HTTPS/HTTP/1.1 path over RxSock and Foreign Runtime/OpenSSL, while Foreign Runtime v0.22.6 supplies ABI-native C scalar aliases for future native browser/runtime bindings.
invariants: API Client v0.3 does not shell out to curl.
OpenSSL is reached through Foreign Runtime memory-BIO bindings while RxSock owns TCP.
TLS requires certificate-chain and hostname verification and fails closed on transport errors.
Foreign Runtime consumers must use C-native aliases such as size_t, ssize_t and socklen_t when the API type is implementation-native, and fixed-width aliases for genuinely fixed-width APIs.
Structs containing ABI-native C types still require ABI-qualified layout metadata.
The currently qualified ABI-specific Foreign Runtime profile is linux-x86_64-le-lp64; other ABIs are not implicitly claimed.

provenance.claim: API Client v0.3 native HTTPS transport and dependency boundary.
v0.22.6 ABI-native C scalar aliases and abi-native-c-scalars capability.
Foreign Runtime ABI qualification is limited to linux-x86_64-le-lp64 in this release.
